name: Uveitis Unveiled
description: Anterior, intermediate, posterior, and panuveitis — masquerade syndromes, systemic associations, step-up therapy, steroids, immunomodulators, and when to refer.

episodes.title: Uveitis Anatomy: The SUN Classification
episodes.description: The Standardization of Uveitis Nomenclature — anterior, intermediate, posterior, panuveitis — and why it matters.

episodes.title: Anterior Uveitis: The Cells and Flare at the Slit Lamp
episodes.description: The grading, the keratic precipitates, the posterior synechiae, and the acute versus chronic distinction.

episodes.title: Acute Anterior Uveitis: The HLA-B27 Connection
episodes.description: The sudden onset, the pain and photophobia, the ankylosing spondylitis link, and the steroid and cycloplegia.

episodes.title: Granulomatous Versus Nongranulomatous: The KP Morphology
episodes.description: Mutton-fat KPs and the sarcoid and TB differential — the morphology that redirects the workup.

episodes.title: Intermediate Uveitis: The Snowballs and the Snowbank
episodes.description: The vitreous cells, the pars plana snowbank, and the multiple sclerosis and Lyme associations.

episodes.title: Posterior Uveitis: The Retinitis and Choroiditis
episodes.description: The lesions beyond the vitreous — toxoplasmosis, ARN, birdshot — and the sight-threatening urgency.

episodes.title: Panuveitis: The Full-Thickness Inflammation
episodes.description: The anterior-to-posterior involvement, the systemic disease search, and the aggressive treatment.

episodes.title: Toxoplasmosis: The “Headlight in the Fog”
episodes.description: The necrotizing retinitis adjacent to a scar, the pyrimethamine and sulfadiazine, and the felis host.

episodes.title: Acute Retinal Necrosis: The Herpes Emergency
episodes.description: The peripheral necrosis, the rapid progression, and the intravenous acyclovir and laser barrier.

episodes.title: Cytomegalovirus Retinitis: The AIDS-Defining Illness
episodes.description: The pizza-pie fundus, the HAART immune recovery, and the ganciclovir implant legacy.

episodes.title: Sarcoidosis: The Great Mimic of Uveitis
episodes.description: The candle-wax drippings, the ACE and chest CT, and the steroid-responsive but chronic course.

episodes.title: Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis: The Silent Uveitis of Children
episodes.description: The ANA-positive oligoarthritis, the asymptomatic anterior uveitis, and the mandatory screening schedule.

episodes.title: Behçet Disease: The Triple Symptom Complex
episodes.description: The oral and genital ulcers, the hypopyon uveitis, and the Silk Road geography.

episodes.title: Vogt-Koyanagi-Harada: The Bilateral Panuveitis
episodes.description: The meningitis, the poliosis and vitiligo, and the high-dose steroid that prevents sunset glow.

episodes.title: Sympathetic Ophthalmia: The Bilateral Threat After Trauma
episodes.description: The fellow eye inflammation, the timing, and the immunosuppression that protects the good eye.
